flashcard_questions.q: What is hard engineering at the coast?
flashcard_questions.a: Building artificial structures to control natural processes.

flashcard_questions.q: What is soft engineering at the coast?
flashcard_questions.a: Working with natural processes to protect the coast without building artificial structures.

flashcard_questions.q: How much does a sea wall cost per metre?
How do groynes build up a wider beach?
flashcard_questions.a: They trap sediment that longshore drift would otherwise move along the coast.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the main drawback of groynes for the coastline down-drift?
flashcard_questions.a: Beaches beyond them are starved of sediment.

flashcard_questions.q: What is rock armour in coastal management?
flashcard_questions.a: Large boulders placed at the base of a cliff to absorb wave energy.

flashcard_questions.q: What are gabions in coastal management?
flashcard_questions.a: Wire-mesh cages filled with rocks that absorb wave energy.

flashcard_questions.q: How much do gabions cost per metre?
What is beach nourishment at the coast?
flashcard_questions.a: Importing sand and shingle from elsewhere to widen the beach.

flashcard_questions.q: What is managed retreat as a coastal strategy?
flashcard_questions.a: Removing existing defences and letting the sea flood the land behind.

flashcard_questions.q: Which habitat forms on the land flooded during managed retreat?
How much did the Lyme Regis coastal defence scheme cost in total?
Which country supplied the sand for beach nourishment at Lyme Regis?
Why are the cliffs at Lyme Regis prone to slumping and landslips?
flashcard_questions.a: They are made of soft unstable clay that slips after heavy rain.

flashcard_questions.q: What was driven into the cliffs at Lyme Regis to stabilise them?

notes: 15 cards: 6 term-to-definition (hard engineering, soft engineering, rock armour, gabions, beach nourishment, managed retreat), 2 strategy-to-effect (groyne function, groyne drawback), 3 figure cards with one figure each (sea wall cost, gabion cost, Lyme Regis total), 4 case-study-to-fact naming Lyme Regis (France sand, clay cliffs, steel nails) plus the salt-marsh outcome. The rock armour cost band was dropped so three similar cost answers could not interfere; beach reprofiling, dune regeneration and the visitor-conflict evaluation were trimmed to stay within 15.
